BT protects the HepG2 and Hep3B cells against Cd-induced apoptosis via different mechanisms, which are related with Fas expression.
the protection of BT is related to the anti-apoptotic effects, which are more effective on Fas-dependent pathway than on Fas-independent pathway.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the protection of betulin against Cd-induced apoptosis is associated with the inhibition of ROS generation, the blocking of the Fas-dependent apoptosis pathway, and the abrogation in caspase activation.

the anti-apoptotic effects of BT are associated with the inhibition of ROS production, the inhibition of Fas upregulations, the inhibition of mitochondrial pathway, as well as with the transient cell cycle arrest at an early time point.
BT may be a potential therapeutic agent for Cd-induced hepatocyte apoptosis.
